text:
anya: Heads up — nightly billing sync failed for ~120 migrated accounts. NetSuite invoices created but missing payment terms, so AR allocation job is erroring out. saw this at 02:10 UTC this morning.

tom: Can you paste the failing log / example invoice id?

anya: example stripe invoice id: inv_3Kxxxxxx. webhook delivered `invoice.created`, payload shows `default_payment_method: null` and `payment_settings: {}` for migrated customers. snippet: ```json
{
  "id": "inv_3Kxxxxxx",
  "customer": "cus_JAbc123",
  "billing_reason": "subscription_cycle",
  "collection_method": "charge_automatically",
  "default_payment_method": null,
  "payment_settings": {},
  "lines": { ... }
}
```

liz: that matches what we saw during the legacy_plan_migration window — we stripped stored payment tokens during the export for PCI reasons and didn't set a fallback on import. many of those customers also don't have customer-level `invoice_settings.default_payment_method`.

matt: NS sync code expects `invoice.default_payment_method` or falls back to customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method to pick terms/mapping. if both null, sync creates invoice with empty terms and NetSuite rejects ledger allocation: ```error:
NetSuiteAPI: InvalidArguments - missing paymentTerms on Invoice create
```

jen: short-term mitigation: patch the sync consumer to default to company fallback `Net-30` when no payment method exists so NetSuite invoice create succeeds. put a flag to only apply to `migrated` tag customers. I'll make a quick PR. :+1:

billing-bot: Alert — billing-sync-consumer job failed 118 times in last 3h. DLQ size: 118. Job run id: billing-sync-2026-03-22-0210.

tom: good. we also need a backfill plan to set invoice settings for migrated customers. options: 1) use last known card token from vault (if we retained mapping), 2) set customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method to a placeholder proxy and send dunning email to collect payment method, 3) leave terms default but ensure accounting handles it.

anya: we don't have vault tokens for ~40% of these accounts (sanitized). For those, I'd prefer setting default terms to Net-30 and sending an automated email asking to update billing method. For the others we can restore payment method mapping and re-run sync.

liz: I'll export list of affected customers (customer ids + migrated flag) and attach to the PR. quick query: `select id from customers where migrated=true and invoice_settings_default_payment_method is null;`

matt: also add a reconciliation job to find orphaned ARs created without terms and tag them for manual review. net-suite team can apply credits if needed.

jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-sync/pull/412 — simple fallback to `Net-30` AND emit audit event `billing:missing_payment_method` for telemetry. will request review from @matt and @liz.

tom: after PR merges, deploy to staging and run small batch re-sync for 10 accounts. if green, roll to prod with feature flag.

anya: I'll schedule the backfill run. ETA for first pass (restore + fallback): EOD today PST. Will post results here.

liz: filing a follow-up: add a validation in the import pipeline so future migrations set customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method or explicit default_terms.

matt: agreed. also add an alert: if DLQ > 50 in 1h then create incident channel.

anya: thanks all. tagging @finance for visibility.

jen: marking owners: jen (temporary patch), anya (backfill + run), liz (export + validation), matt (NS reconciliation).

billing-bot: Incident auto-create suppressed (policy: non-customer-impacting).

anya: (post-deploy) small batch resync completed, 10/10 succeeded with fallback. re-running full backfill now. will update if failures remain.
